title: Document the deploy model on p.apyr.us: Amplify deploys, Actions or local CI with a LeftBlock receipt
description:
Repo: AnthusAI/p.apyr.us (public; content PRs merge freely per Ryan 2026-10-25). Files: a docs page under `docs/` or `content/` (follow the repo's docs section convention) titled "How a Papyrus site deploys".
Content: Amplify is deploy-only (why: cost, 10–14 min builds, $0.01/min); public repos run CI in GitHub Actions and the merge starts the Amplify job through OIDC; private repos run CI locally and `leftblock ci` issues a receipt (GitHub status `leftblock/ci`) that the Amplify build verifies before installing anything; staging builds on demand; failed-build policy (read the log first); monthly cost check; links to LeftBlock README and docs/site-hosting.md. Serve it as Markus source per the standing rule.
Acceptance: page live on p.apyr.us; screenshots not required (docs page); closes the epic.
